scope: Synthetic data generated with actual application RevisionStore/StudioNotebook, built Jems UI, real Chromium localStorage/IndexedDB; desktop emulation on one shared Linux host. No network provider or cloud data. Native record operations use the production source classes. Legacy export/restore timing excludes originals, rewards, Pals and cloud; full backup is measured separately.
instrumentation: Synchronous JSON and localStorage instrumentation adds overhead; byte counters are UTF-16 code units, separately exported UTF-8 bytes. Startup includes browser navigation and readiness wait. Process metrics are CDP observations, not isolated CPU or physical-device memory. Samples share warm HTTP cache and accumulate one retained revision per sample.
